verdict.rationale: Parsec documents an Enterprise high-performance relay that lets teams connect through a relay point in their own firewall, and says connections are peer-to-peer and never pass through Parsec's infrastructure. That puts session traffic on customer-controlled paths, but the relay is Enterprise-gated and its self-hosting is described only briefly. missing for 10: explicit self-hosted relay deployment documentation, any self-hostable rendezvous/signaling server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run

citations.quote: The Parsec high-performance relay is also available to Enterprise customers so your team can connect through a relay point in your firewall.
All connections traveling through Parsec are peer-to-peer. They never pass through Parsec's infrastructure
